rows.en: L-let's switch to walking today.

Sigh... It's not really anything to brag about,
though...

(I didn't get any of my own training done,
but I guess it was nice to see an unexpected
side of Claire-senpai.)
(Today's the rematch from last time...)
rows.notes: Rebenji: from the following lines it is a rematch between Claire and the player (she vows to crush the player and loses again); the sport is never named.

rows.en:
Sorry, I'm a little late, aren't I?
\p-kun.
No, I just got here myself.

Oh, that won't do. Being right on time?
You should get there early and wait for the lady!

...Geez, that's rich, coming from the one
who showed up late...

Hehehe, just kidding!
I'm really sorry, okay?

Don't worry about it!
Now then, let's have our rematch
from the other day.
Hmph! I'm gonna beat you to a pulp!!

(The one who got beaten to a pulp
was Claire-senpai.)
...Shall we head home...
Cheer up, Senpai...
Mm, you're right...

(I'd like to help Senpai get
a little more athletic...)
(Today's the rematch from last time...)

Sorry, I'm a little late, aren't I?
\p-chan.
No, I just got here myself.

Oh, that won't do. Being right on time...
You should always aim to be five minutes early.

...Geez, that's rich, coming from the one
who showed up late~

Don't worry about it.
Now then, let's have our rematch
from the other day.

(Perfect beach weather!
Today I'm gonna have tons of fun
with Claire-senpai!!)

You seem pretty excited,
\p-kun.

Of course! We're going to the beach!
The weather's great too, I'm so excited!!

Hehehe, then let's go get changed.
We'll meet up again later.

Guess I was faster, of course.
I hope Senpai gets here soon.
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Oh, Claire-senpa...
(Th-this is...!!)
What do you think of this swimsuit?

It's amazing!
I think it looks great on you!!
You're exaggerating, but I'm happy.
(She's too dazzling...)

There sure are a lot of people, though...
I wonder if there's any room left
to put up a parasol?
I've got that covered, so don't worry!
What do you want to do next? Go swimming?
Let's see... I'll sunbathe.
(She's not good at exercise, after all...)
Is there some problem?

No, there's not!!
None at all, really!
rows.notes: The player's garbled over-polite 'arimasen desu' shows panic; rendered as flustered denial.

rows.en: If you say so.
I-I'll go buy us something to drink.

Oh, never mind the drinks.
There's something I'd like you to help me with.
Help? With what??
Could you rub some oil on me?
I can't reach my back by myself.
Whaaat??
Come ooon... Hurry uuup...
*gulp*...
It's my first time, so be gentle with me...?
(Th-this is bliss~)
Aah~ That was fun!
I'm glad you enjoyed it.
Didn't you have fun?
I'm really tired... but it was fun...
(I can still feel it on my hands...)

Hehe, you're so cute, kouhai-kun,
teasing you is just too much fun~
rows.notes: kouhai-kun as in c04288. Review: Claire's kouhai-kun/-chan kept as 'kouhai-kun'/'kouhai-chan', like -senpai.

rows.en: P-please don't tease me!

Hehe!
Well then, let's head home together.

(That was a fun day~
I'll try inviting her again.)
(Today's perfect beach weather!)

You seem pretty excited,
\p-chan.

It's been ages since I went to the beach!
The weather's great too, I'm so excited!!
Hehehe, then let's go get changed together.

Th-there's something about the look
in your eyes...
Heh heh heh heh...

I sensed danger and changed right away, but...
I hope Senpai gets here soon.
(Wh-what in the world...!!)
I think it looks great on you!!
Yours looks great on you too.
(Is she even the same species as me...?!)
(She's not good at exercise, after all...)
No problem at all!!
I-I'll go buy us something to drink.
(Whoa~ What is this~...)

Hehe, you're so cute, kouhai-chan,
teasing you is just too much fun~
rows.notes: kouhai-chan as in c04306. Review: Claire's kouhai-kun/-chan kept as 'kouhai-kun'/'kouhai-chan', like -senpai.

rows.en: (Another beach vacation with Claire-senpai today!)

The artificial island is such a great place,
no matter how many times you come.
Well then, shall we go get changed?

uncertain: c04311/c04324/c04317/c04329: 'rebenji' rendered 'rematch'. The lines that follow make it a rematch between Claire and the player (she vows to crush the player and is crushed); the sport is never named.
c04358: Claire's innuendo ('It's my first time, so be gentle with me...?') kept at full strength.
c04386: jinkoutou rendered 'the artificial island' (lowercase common noun, as c23059); not in the glossary.
missing_glossary: jinkoutou (artificial island, campus beach outing spot; c04386): rendered 'the artificial island'.
